title: Florence's Secret Cat Ban
topic: Why the medieval city of Florence banned cats in the 14th century (to protect silk production from rodent damage)

lines: A silk weaver chased a mouse through his workshop, claws flashing.
His neighbors laughed, saying a cat would solve it.
The mouse multiplies, gnaws bolts of silk, the loom stops.
You see, it’s like a pantry raid when you leave crumbs out.
Florence bans cats to protect its valuable silk from rodent damage.
Ironically, the ban hurt the weavers more than the mice.
